name: Unidentified RA-7 protocol droid (Renzoh Silliac)
description: An RA-7 protocol droid served the Blood Oath Syndicate member Renzoh Silliac on the planet Hallitron-7. After a brief skirmish, the protocol droid was interrogated by the Palliduvan bounty hunter Aurra Sing and coerced into unlocking Silliac's computer.
